name: Home Page
description: Vistrah primary landing page featuring header, search, hero carousel, curated services, promotional banners and V Ads spotlight.

available_variations.name: Standard Sticky Header
available_variations.description: Fixed top bar with logo, category navigation & profile actions.

available_variations.name: Minimal Transparent Scrim
available_variations.description: Blends seamlessly into hero banner with subtle dark contrast gradient.

available_variations.name: Centered Brand Lockup
available_variations.description: Prominent central Vistrah insignia with split utility menus.

available_variations.name: Elevated with Service Tabs
available_variations.description: Includes 3 service pathway quick-selector tabs.

features.label: Customer Location Pill
features.description: Displays currently selected GPS city or pin.

features.label: Member Badge
features.description: Highlights active Vistrah Gold or Business member status.

features.label: Quick Cart / Orders
features.description: Direct access to cart and active purchase orders.

available_variations.name: Hero Centered with GPS Chips
available_variations.description: Prominent large input with auto-detect GPS chips and voice assistant.

available_variations.name: Header Compact Bar
available_variations.description: Streamlined input embedded in the top app navigation bar.

available_variations.name: Floating with Trending Pills
available_variations.description: Includes trending keyword chips directly underneath search.

available_variations.name: Predictive Filter Bar
available_variations.description: Shows real-time dropdown suggestions with category and provider badges.

features.label: GPS Use My Location
features.description: Requires explicit button tap for privacy compliance.

features.label: Voice Search Assistant
features.description: Allows microphone input for localized service searches.

features.label: Recent Search History
features.description: Displays previous search suggestions for faster repeat lookup.

available_variations.name: Cinematic Rotating Carousel
available_variations.description: Full-bleed slides with automatic smooth rotation and dots navigation.

available_variations.name: Split Hero with CTA
available_variations.description: Left text copy with headline and right high-res image showcase.

available_variations.name: Gradient Scrim Spotlight
available_variations.description: Cinematic brand gradient with floating highlighted service cards.

available_variations.name: Dynamic Video Backdrop
available_variations.description: Background looping video with sound toggle and overlay text.

features.label: Auto-rotate Slides
features.description: Slides automatically every 5 seconds when idle.

features.label: Seasonal Promotional Badge
features.description: Highlights festive deals (e.g. "Diwali Special: Up to 40% Off").

features.label: Primary CTA Button
features.description: Displays high-visibility button navigating to services or offers.

available_variations.name: Adaptive 4x2 Responsive Grid
available_variations.description: Smart responsive grid adjusting from 2 columns on mobile to 4 on desktop.

available_variations.name: Horizontal Swipeable Rail
available_variations.description: Smooth sideways scrolling photo card rail for mobile and phone view.

available_variations.name: Circular Category Icon Rail
available_variations.description: Compact category icons with live service count badges.

available_variations.name: Fixed-Price Commerce Tiles
available_variations.description: Displays fixed rupee pricing and instant Add to Cart buttons.

features.label: Star Ratings & Review Count
features.description: Shows verified customer review score on each card.

features.label: Price Tag / Estimate
features.description: Displays Starting at ₹X or Fixed Price per unit.

features.label: Verified Provider Badge
features.description: Green verification badge for approved local businesses.

features.label: Direct Enquiry Action
features.description: Allows requesting a quick quote directly from the card.

available_variations.name: Full-bleed Promotional Billboard
available_variations.description: Edge-to-edge promotional banner with contrast background and coupon code badge.

available_variations.name: Twin Half-width Banners
available_variations.description: Two complementary banners side-by-side.

available_variations.name: Flash Sale Countdown Ribbon
available_variations.description: Thin high-visibility banner with active countdown timer.

available_variations.name: Accent Spotlight Callout
available_variations.description: Curved card container with gradient border and verified guarantee seal.

features.label: Coupon Code Pill
features.description: Copyable voucher code (e.g. "VISTRAH100").

features.label: Offer Expiry Countdown
features.description: Displays remaining hours/days for urgency.

features.label: Clickable Entire Banner
features.description: Entire banner area acts as direct link.

available_variations.name: Vertical 9:16 Video Reels Teaser
available_variations.description: Embedded vertical reels feed with sound control and Explore Product / Brand buttons.

available_variations.name: 16:9 Video Showcase Card
available_variations.description: Full-frame video demonstration card with engagement metrics.

available_variations.name: Creator Studio Onboarding Widget
available_variations.description: Promotes free seller video advertising and creator tools.

available_variations.name: Multi-video Interactive Slider
available_variations.description: Horizontal carousel of multiple trending community ads.

features.label: Autoplay When in View
features.description: Autoplays video taking the largest visible screen area.

features.label: Explore Product / Brand Button
features.description: Opens product details sheet or navigates to brand profile.

features.label: Engagement Stats (Likes & Views)
features.description: Displays live community metrics.

features.label: Interactive Sound Control
features.description: Allows one-tap mute / unmute.
